packages.label: Dynamic fluid-structure interaction (soft solids in lattice Boltzmann flow)
packages.scope: Two-way coupled fluid-structure interaction on the fixed lattice: moving-occupancy lattice Boltzmann flow (D2Q9/D3Q19/D3Q27, BGK/TRT/MRT/cumulant, laminar/Smagorinsky/WALE, partially saturated cells or Brinkman penalization, ports, sponges) coupled to large-deformation soft solids (soft-matter laws, mixed u-p, AVF midpoint or generalized-alpha, Rayleigh/Prony damping, rigid-plane contact) with subcycling and loose / IQN-ILS / Newton-Krylov coupling; density topology optimization with exact gradients of time-weighted, windowed and cycle-averaged responses over fixed horizons and forced or autonomous periodic orbits, regime screening and refusal of chaotic regimes. Screening physics, not qualified.
